Guidance

MCA approved doctors UK based

A list of doctors in the UK who can carry out ENG 1 medicals.

From:
Maritime and Coastguard Agency
Published:
6 May 2014
Last updated:
20 August 2026 — See all updates

Documents

HTML

HTML

HTML

HTML

MCA Approved doctors within the Crown Dependencies

Details

The attached lists are for seafarers who need to get an ENG1 medical fitness certificate, and to find a Maritime and Coastguard Agency (MCA) approved doctor in the UK.

Doctors details are regularly updated and contain information as of the 20th August 2026.

Please find attached lists for

England

Northern Ireland

Scotland

Wales

Crown Dependencies
